recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Reintroducing separate usedCode/usedReference elements or adding redundant prose would be contrary to the current R5/R6 CodeableReference design.
issue_request: Published Patient Care change request, resolved Persuasive, asking Procedure.used to support CodeableConcept or Reference by replacing it with usedCode 0..* CodeableConcept and usedReference 0..* Reference(Medication|Substance|Device).
initial_application: SVN r9015, imported as git commit c725899b327ab6d1589f58c19d65d3fc96c7ca87, replaced Procedure.used with Procedure.usedCode and Procedure.usedReference and updated Procedure examples.
additional_context: FHIR-3715 introduced the original supplies-used element. FHIR-31539 later records that R5 had already accomplished the code-or-reference capability through CodeableReference. source/fhir.ini maps both Procedure.usedCode and Procedure.usedReference to Procedure.used for the current build.
reconciliation: No source change was needed. Current Procedure.used is a repeating CodeableReference with concept support and references to Device, Medication, Substance, and BiologicallyDerivedProduct, preserving the FHIR-9821 semantics in the current datatype.
